title: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
author: Raze
summary: Find tokens, beetles, and chests on your map and minimap. Height arrows show items above or below you. Choose which maps and items show markers, with custom symbols, colors, and size.

required_mods.name: REFramework
required_mods.notes: Required. Install REFramework for Dragon's Dogma 2 before this mod.

main_file.name: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
main_file.description: Version 1.2. Adds minimap height arrows and independent full-map visibility, fixes the marker-name script error, and includes zoom, beetle-state, and packaging fixes. Requires REFramework. Install the complete ZIP and restart the game.
